title: Your organization access changed.
accountBody: You are still signed in, but RFxchange cannot open a participant workspace until an active organization membership is restored or established. Ask an organization administrator to restore your membership or use a valid invitation, then recheck access.
organizationBody: RFxchange will not transfer the previous organization’s activation or OPEN status to another organization. Review the active memberships below. Workspace access stays blocked until a governed organization-specific access path is established.
selectedTitle: This membership is active, but the previous activation does not transfer.
selectedBody: For safety, RFxchange keeps the previous organization’s lifecycle bound to that organization. Recheck after the appropriate organization access has been established.
boundary: This page changes no membership, organization authority, lifecycle, or restriction state.
